description: Source code for the Windows DHCP PAC file adapter fetcher in Chromium, handling DHCP queries to retrieve PAC URLs via Windows DHCP API and managing fetch operations.

classes.name: DhcpPacFileAdapterFetcher
classes.description: Handles DHCP-based PAC URL fetching on Windows, including DHCP API interaction and fetch management.

classes.name: DhcpQuery
classes.description: Represents a DHCP query to retrieve PAC URL for a specific network adapter.

methods.name: GetPacURLFromDhcp
methods.description: Static method to retrieve PAC URL from DHCP server for a given network adapter.

methods.name: SanitizeDhcpApiString
methods.description: Sanitizes DHCP API string data to ASCII, trims whitespace and handles embedded nulls.
